description.narrative: The project will improve the operational performance of the power sector and contribute to the Government of Bangladesh's target to achieve electricity for all by 2021 through (i) constructing (a) a 400/132-kilovolt (kV) substation at Gopalganj; (b) a 230 kV transmission line in the southern zone, from Barisal to Faridpur; and (c) a 400 kV transmission line in the western zone, from Bogra to Rohanpur; and (ii) implementing a capacity development program in the electric utility industry to promote socially and gender inclusive growth . The project will use state-of-the-art conductors with higher power transmission capacity and lower energy loss in both the 230 kV and 400 kV transmission lines.

description.narrative: Capacity of electricity supply in Bangladesh increased

Carbon dioxide emissions reduced by 174,595 tons per year from transmission loss reduction Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: CO2 emission data will be calculated after end of the project. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB
Transmission loss reduced to 2.5% Achievement: 2.7 Progress/Status: Transmission Loss for FY 2024-25 (up to April, 2025): 3.05% Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB

Power delivery capacity of southern and western grid increased to 14,135 MVA Achievement: 9000 Progress/Status: Power delivery capacity increased by 4965 MVA (incremental) after construction of 1. Gopalganj 400/132 kV substation, 2. Augmentation of Gopalganj substation, 3. Bogura new substaion, 4. Rohanpur substation and 5. Augmentation of Faridpur substation. Current capacity is 13969 MVA. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB
Output/s as listed by the project staff.

Output: New substation at Gopalganj installed Indicator: Gopalganj (North) 400/132 kV substation with capacity of 3x325 MVA constructed and commissioned Achievement: 975 Progress/Status: Construction of Gopalganj (North) 400/132 kV substation with capacity of 3x325 MVA completed by June 2023. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB

Output: Socially inclusive capacity in the electric utility industry enhanced Indicator: 30 PGCB staff completed a university program relevant to energy sector Achievement: 0 Progress/Status: 36 PGCB staffs already received training from Korea. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB

Output: Transmission network in southern Bangladesh expanded Indicator: 126 km Barisal (North)-Gopalganj (North)-Faridpur 230 kV double-circuit line constructed and commissioned Achievement: N Progress/Status: Construction completed for 123.81 km of 230kV transmission line on 3 June 2022. The line was energized on 1 July 2024 and power flow started since then. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in southern Bangladesh expanded Indicator: Gopalganj (North) substation augmented with 400/230 kV, 2x750 MVA transformers Achievement: N Progress/Status: Construction completed on 1 Jul 2024. This is now operational. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in southern Bangladesh expanded Indicator: Two 230 kV bay extensions at existing Barisal (North) substation constructed and commissioned, and the existing Faridpur 132/33 kV substation augmented with four 132 kV bays; five 230 kV bays; and 230/132 kV, 2x250 MVA transformers (2017 baseline: 0) Achievement: N Progress/Status: GIS Bay extension completed for Barishal substation by adding two new lines. It was commissioned on 22 March 2023. Bay extension completed for Faridpur substation by adding new transformer. The capacity is enhanced by 700 MVA. It was commissioned on 28 Dec 2023. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in western Bangladesh expanded Indicator: 11 km line-in, line-out connection from Barapukuria-Bogra (South) 230 kV transmission line to Bogra (West) substation, and 1 km line-in, line-out connection from Chowdala-Niamatpur 132 kV transmission line to Rohanpur substation constructed and commissioned Achievement: N Progress/Status: Construction completed for 11 km LILO on 2 March 2023. Construction completed for 1 km LILO on 8 Feb 2024. Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in western Bangladesh expanded Indicator: New 104 km Bogra (West)-Rohanpur 400 kV double-circuit line constructed and commissioned Achievement: N Progress/Status: 104 km Borga (west)-Rohanpur 400 kV double circuit line constructed and commissioned on 21 June 2023.
Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in western Bangladesh expanded Indicator: New 26 km Chapainawabganj-Rohanpur 132 kV double-circuit transmission line constructed and commissioned Achievement: N Progress/Status: 26 km Chapainawabganj- Rohanpur 132 km line constructed and commissioned on 28 May 2022. Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in western Bangladesh expanded Indicator: New Bogra (West) substation constructed and commissioned with 400/230 kV, 2x750 MVA transformers, nine 400 kV bays, and eleven 230 kV bays Achievement: N Progress/Status: Construction of new Bogra substation completed on 9 March 2023 by adding 2250 MVA in the system.
Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in western Bangladesh expanded Indicator: New Rohanpur substation constructed and commissioned with 400/132 kV, 2x325 MVA transformers; five 400 kV bays; and nine 132 kV bays Achievement: N Progress/Status: Construction of Rohanpur substation completed on 8 Jul 2024 adding 1040MVA in the system.
Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in western Bangladesh expanded Indicator: Two 132 kV bay extensions at existing Chapainawabganj substation constructed and commissioned Achievement: N Progress/Status: Construction completed for Two 132 kV bay extensions at existing Chapainawabganj substation. Energization completed on 8 July 2023. Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value: N

Output: Transmission network in southern Bangladesh expanded Indicator: 41 km 230 kV double circuit transmission line constructed and commissioned from the Notun Biddyut Power Plant to Char Fasson substation. (2021 baseline:0) Progress/Status: Commissioning of Notun Bidyut Bay is targeted for the first week of February 2026. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission network in southern Bangladesh expanded Indicator: A new 230/33kV GIS Substation with capacity of 280 MVA at Char Fasson island, and 2 x GIS 230kV line bay extensions constructed at the Notun Biddyut Power Plant at Char Burhanuddin island. (2021 baseline: 0) Progress/Status: The transformers arrived at Chittagong Port on 25.01.2025. The commissioning target for Charfasson Substation is within March 2026. Data Source: Annual reports of PGCB Actual value:

Output: Transmission network in western Bangladesh expanded Indicator: Reconductoring of existing 175 km, 230kV East-West Interconnection transmission lines and 148 km 132 kV transmission lines in the Northwestern part of Bangladesh constructed and commissioned. (2021 Baseline: 0) Progress/Status: The 132 kV re-stringing works are almost completed; the remaining portion will be finished within this week. The 230 kV re-stringing works are currently ongoing and are expected to be completed by June 2026. Data Source: Annual Reports of PGCB Actual value:
